description: Discover the cabinet rule through calibration feedback, then start the belt and file every moving specimen into the matching moving drawer mouth. Holding or selecting a filing tab does not stop the belt. A release into the cabinet that misses a mouth, a wrong file, lost specimen or early seal ends the case. Release back onto the belt to cancel safely. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, implementation or hidden-state access. Do not interact with unrelated, blank or browser-settings tabs. Task-created tabs may be used only through their visible controls.
